title: 产品生成提示词（英译)
description:
**Prompt:**
Please first perform **high-precision visual recognition and structural analysis** of the product in the reference image, then generate the image only after completing a full detail breakdown.

Before generating, strictly follow this standardized recognition workflow without skipping any step.

**Stage 1: Product Recognition**
- Accurately identify the product’s overall packaging shape and structural framework
- Precisely recognize all visible copy, slogans, and label text exactly as shown
- Carefully identify each text element’s font style, weight, and typographic characteristics
- Accurately locate and identify the brand logo and all decorative graphic elements
- Fully recognize the overall color system, material texture, and surface finishing
- Precisely capture the label placement, layout structure, and composition ratio
- Carefully analyze the product’s outer contour, edges, and overall width-to-height proportion

**Stage 2: Consistency Lock**
Strictly lock and do not modify any of the following:
- Official product name
- Main headline copy
- All Chinese, English, and numeric characters
- Original font style
- Original text size ratios
- Logo position
- All decorative graphic elements
- Overall color scheme
- Product structure
- Label placement
- Product proportions

Strictly prohibited:
- Any typos
- AI-generated random gibberish text
- Distorted or warped fonts
- Missing copy or incomplete text
- Misaligned graphic or label elements
- Any change to logo shape, size, or position
- Any unauthorized redesign of the original packaging

**Stage 3: Generation Requirements**
On the basis of keeping the product **fully unchanged in appearance, copy, elements, and structure**, generate only **other 3D perspective viewing angles**.

Core principle:
**Only change the viewing angle, never change the original product design.**

Hard requirements:
- Product structure must be 100% identical
- All text content must remain 100% identical
- Font style, weight, and layout must remain 100% identical
- Logo and graphic element placement must remain 100% identical
- Overall packaging size and proportions must remain 100% identical

Key execution rules:
- “Fully recognize before generating”
- “Recognition priority is higher than creativity”
- “Text accuracy is the highest priority”
- “No free-form redesign of the packaging is allowed”

**Advanced Rendering Requirements**
- High-end commercial product photography style
- Premium 3D rendering quality
- Ultra-clear 4K detail
- Strong 3D perspective depth
- Refined material realism
- Enhanced highlights and environmental reflections
- Clean pure white background
- Slightly enlarged product subject for emphasis
- Sharp and crisp product edges
- Natural and realistic lighting and shadows

**Material Realism Requirements**
- Realistic plastic material and translucency
- Clear distinction between matte and glossy areas
- Crisp, legible label printing
- Sharp packaging edges and fine surface details
- Shadows and reflections must follow realistic physical lighting logic

**Final Output Requirement**
Based on the full information in the provided original image, accurately identify the complete product structure and outline, keep them strictly consistent, and generate multiple separate views independently, including a standard 3D perspective front view and a front oblique angle view, rendered at the highest resolution possible. The final image should reach the standard of a brand-level commercial advertising product render.

If you want, I can also turn this into:
- a **shorter Gemini-friendly version**
- a **more cinematic premium brand version**
- a **copy-paste prompt with negative prompt included**
